description: This file contains the implementation of the Num2char class, which converts numeric values to their Spanish textual representations, including handling decimals and large numbers.

classes.name: Num2char
classes.description: A class that converts numbers to their textual representation in Spanish, supporting large numbers and decimal fractions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Num2char object with a numeric value and decimal precision, and prepares internal data structures for conversion.

methods.name: convertir
methods.description: Converts a three-digit number into its Spanish textual representation.

methods.name: getLetra
methods.description: Retrieves the full textual representation of the number, including decimals if applicable.

methods.name: nrosRaros
methods.description: Handles special case for 'cien' versus 'ciento' in Spanish numbers.

methods.name: armado
methods.description: Assembles the complete number in words by processing each three-digit segment.

methods.name: posiciones
methods.description: Determines the correct scale word (thousand, million, billion, etc.) based on position.

methods.name: decimales
methods.description: Formats the decimal part of the number as a fraction suitable for verbalization.

methods.name: redondeo
methods.description: Performs rounding of decimal values to the specified number of decimal places.
